name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability for Flask-RPBAC
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or Motivation

Explain the problem this feature would solve, who would benefit from it, and why the current
behavior or available workaround is insufficient.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the behavior, API, or user experience you would like to see. Include important
compatibility or design considerations.

## Example Usage

Show how an application developer or user could use the proposed feature.


## Alternatives Considered

Describe alternative solutions, existing features, or workarounds you have considered and why
they do not fully solve the problem.

## Additional Context

Add related examples, links, use cases, or implementation ideas that provide useful context.

## Checklist

- I have searched existing issues to avoid creating a duplicate.
- This request is focused on one feature or improvement.
- I have considered how this may affect the existing public API.
- I have not included secrets or private information.
